title: Local dimension testing via quadratic obstructions
summary: We give an algorithm, based on second-order necessary conditions, to test whether a point is isolated on an algebraic set. Using this subroutine, we develop an algorithm that bounds the local dimension of an algebraic set at a point. The principal computation in our isolation test is governed by the nullity of the Jacobian, avoiding the combinatorial growth of classical methods. For exact input, the bound returned by the algorithm is certified. We compare our approach with classical methods.
